title: Miniature Morphing Geometry Diorama
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a miniature morphing geometry diorama with the following specifications:

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 3, 6) looking at origin.
- Add a soft ambient light (intensity 0.4, color 0xffffff) and a directional light at (5, 8, 5) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Create a circular platform (CylinderGeometry radius 3, height 0.2) with a dark wood-like MeshStandardMaterial (color 0x3a2518) centered at origin. This is the diorama base.
- Load the 'BarramundiFish.glb' model using GLTFLoader. Scale it to fit roughly 1.5 units long. Place it at position (0, 1.2, 0) on the diorama. Store the loaded model reference.

## Morphing Geometry Objects
Create 5 morphing geometry pedestals arranged in a circle (radius 1.8) on the platform:
- Pedestal 0 (front): Icosahedron (radius 0.3) at angle 0° — color 0xff4444
- Pedestal 1: Octahedron (radius 0.3) at angle 72° — color 0x44ff44
- Pedestal 2: Dodecahedron (radius 0.3) at angle 144° — color 0x4444ff
- Pedestal 3: Tetrahedron (radius 0.3) at angle 216° — color 0xffff44
- Pedestal 4: Torus (radius 0.2, tube 0.08) at angle 288° — color 0xff44ff
Each geometry sits on a small cylindrical pedestal (radius 0.15, height 0.4) colored 0x888888. The geometries float 0.15 units above their pedestals (y offset from platform surface).

## Morph Modes
Implement 3 morph modes cycled by pressing 'M':
- Mode 0 'idle': geometries gently bob up and down (sin wave, amplitude 0.1, period 2s)
- Mode 1 'pulse': geometries scale between 0.8 and 1.4 rhythmically (sin wave, period 1.5s)
- Mode 2 'spin': geometries spin on their local Y axis at 2 radians/sec AND orbit slightly (radius 0.1 circular offset around their base position, period 3s)

## Fish Animation
- The fish should slowly orbit the center at radius 1.0, height y=1.5, completing one revolution every 8 seconds. It should face its direction of travel (tangent to orbit).
- Press 'F' to toggle fish visibility on/off.
- Press 'J' to make the fish "jump": animate it up by 1.0 unit over 0.3s then back down over 0.3s. Track whether a jump is in progress.

## Color Cycling
- Press 'C' to cycle the color theme. There are 3 themes:
  - Theme 0: original colors as specified above
  - Theme 1: all geometries become shades of blue (0x1144aa, 0x2255bb, 0x3366cc, 0x4477dd, 0x5588ee)
  - Theme 2: all geometries become shades of orange (0xff6600, 0xff7711, 0xff8822, 0xff9933, 0xffaa44)

## Selection
- Press keys '1'-'5' to select a geometry (index 0-4). Selected geometry gets an emissive highlight (emissive color 0xffffff, emissive intensity 0.3). Only one can be selected at a time. Press the same key to deselect.
- Press 'Delete' or 'Backspace' to hide the selected geometry (set visible=false). Press 'R' to restore all hidden geometries.

## Camera Controls
- Press 'ArrowLeft'/'ArrowRight' to orbit camera around Y axis by 15 degrees per press.
- The camera always looks at origin.

## HUD
- Top-left overlay showing: current morph mode name, current theme index, selected geometry index (-1 if none), fish visible status, number of hidden geometries, camera angle in degrees.
- Style: semi-transparent black background, white text, monospace font, padding 10px.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- morphMode: (0, 1, or 2)
- morphModeName: ('idle', 'pulse', 'spin')
- themeIndex: (0, 1, or 2)
- selectedGeometry: (-1 or 0-4)
- fishVisible: (boolean)
- fishJumping: (boolean)
- fishPositionX: (number, fish world X)
- fishPositionY: (number, fish world Y)
- fishPositionZ: (number, fish world Z)
- hiddenCount: (number of hidden geometries, 0-5)
- cameraAngleDeg: (number, camera orbit angle in degrees)
- geometryScales: [array of 5 numbers, current scale.x of each geometry]
- geometryVisible: [array of 5 booleans]
- platformExists: (boolean)
- elapsedTime: (number, seconds since start)
- geometryColors: [array of 5 hex color integers of current geometry materials]
- fishModelLoaded: (boolean, true once GLB is loaded)
physics_constraints: Geometries must stay within the diorama bounds (within radius 3 of origin). Fish orbit must maintain constant radius of 1.0 from center. All position values must be NaN-free. Scale values must remain positive and bounded between 0.5 and 2.0.
